step.title: Count the sevens with a seeded generator
step.instructions: In dice.ipynb, in one cell make rng = np.random.default_rng(42), roll two dice 1000 times with rng.integers(1, 7, size=(1000, 2)) and print how many rolls sum to 7. Run the cell twice: it must print the same count both times.

targets.caption: The seed makes the rolls repeat

step.code:
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
rolls = rng.integers(1, 7, size=(1000, 2))
sevens = (rolls.sum(axis=1) == 7).sum()

cells.source:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

rolls = rng.integers(1, 7, size=(1000, 2))
sevens = (rolls.sum(axis=1) == 7).sum()
print('sevens:', sevens)
